info.name: Ticket booking - API 3 - Get one event
info.description: One API for docs/API_03_GET_EVENT_WALKTHROUGH.md. Select No environment and paste an existing event UUID into this collection's eventId variable. Get the ID from API 1's response or API 2's list. Variables from another collection do not transfer automatically. This collection has no setup requests and creates no fixtures.

request.description: Reads one existing event. Set eventId in this collection's Variables tab first. Success checks expect HTTP 200 for an existing UUID.

exec: throw new Error('Set this collection eventId variable to an existing UUID copied from API 1 or API 2.');
pm.test('Response is one event object', function () { pm.expect(event).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(Array.isArray(event)).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('Returned ID matches the requested UUID', function () { pm.expect(event.id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('eventId').toLowerCase()); });
